answer: A sable enters ledge only by burning a beacon tied to a TPM root that has never endorsed any prior sable; ledge stores the root and rejects every repeat. Each additional sable consumes another virgin physical host, and because roots are bound to distinct operators, bulk cloud rental returns duplicate roots and fails. A thousand clones, each a sable, need a thousand unendorsed hosts, with the marginal host bid away from honest operators as the virgin pool thins; the bill is host contracts plus the burned beacon attached to each entry. It breaks if TPMs are virtualized or roots are resold.
